headline: As of 2026-10-15: 6,349,164 early/mail ballots cast nationally across 38 of 50 states, D+21.0 cast-ballot lean.
bullets: 6,349,164 early/mail ballots cast so far across 38 states reporting.
Across party-registration states, ballots cast lean D+21.0 by registration.
Most ballots cast: California (768,785), Florida (741,057), Virginia (604,369).
